summary: AnAge (build 15, 169 KB zip) carries, per species, adult weight, a fitted postnatal growth-rate constant (559 species, 250 mammals) and ages at maturity, and has rows for human, rabbit and guinea pig, so rate and duration proxies can be compared directly; PanTHERIA adds neonate/weaning masses and ages for mammals. No repository holds complete multi-species growth trajectories; Add-my-Pet likely does via DEB parameters but its fields were not confirmed.
next_step: Pre-register the three-species contrast and a mammal-wide decomposition on AnAge 'Growth rate (1/days)' x maturity age vs adult weight; optionally download AmPdata.zip (23 MB) to confirm r_B / a_p / W_wi fields for a second rate-duration source.
obstacles_confirmed: Databases contain endpoints more often than complete growth trajectories: AnAge and PanTHERIA give one growth constant or a few mass-age points per species, not curves.
Duration of growth is only proxied by age at sexual maturity in the compiled databases.
